Concrete ExploreDataset backend over a canonical AnnData (.h5ad)

Source: R/ExploreDatasetH5AD.R
ExploreDatasetH5AD.Rd

Reads a canonical exploreDE/1.0 AnnData and implements the accessor contract inherited from ExploreDataset. Accepts a path to a .h5ad file or a live anndataR object. This is the backend for user-supplied data ("bring your own data") and the eventual single backend once producers emit canonical .h5ad directly.

Value

An R6 class generator; $new() returns an ExploreDatasetH5AD object.

ExploreDataset -> ExploreDatasetH5AD

ExploreDatasetH5AD$new()

Read a canonical .h5ad or take a live AnnData, build the config from it, and prepare the feature and DE tables.

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$new(input)

Arguments

input

An anndataR AnnData object, or a path to an existing .h5ad file.

ExploreDatasetH5AD$backend()

The AnnData parts read at construction, as list(obs, var, layers, varm, uns) of plain R objects.

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$backend()

ExploreDatasetH5AD$backend_kind()

Returns "h5ad".

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$backend_kind()

ExploreDatasetH5AD$samples()

Sample metadata from obs, with the factor_ prefix stripped from column names and a Name column added when missing.

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$samples()

ExploreDatasetH5AD$features()

Feature annotation from var, with feature_id and display_name columns, ordered by the p-value of the primary contrast.

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$features()

ExploreDatasetH5AD$de()

DE table of one contrast from varm, with the legacy aliases log2Ratio, pValue and fdr added; an empty data.frame when the slot is missing. Errors on an unknown contrast.

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$de(contrast)

Arguments

contrast

Contrast name, one of contrasts().

ExploreDatasetH5AD$assay_names()

Canonical assay names from the config's assay map whose layer exists; computed assays are always included.

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$assay_names()

ExploreDatasetH5AD$assay()

One assay as a features x samples matrix (the layer transposed); normalised, normalised_log2, vst, fpkm and tpm are computed when the config maps them to no layer.

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$assay(name, features = NULL, samples = NULL)

Arguments

name

Canonical assay name, one of assay_names().

features

Feature IDs (rows) to keep; NULL keeps all.

samples

Sample IDs (columns) to keep; NULL keeps all.

ExploreDatasetH5AD$enrichment()

Enrichment results of one contrast and kind, rebuilt from uns$enrichment and uns$enrichment_support.

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$enrichment(contrast, kind)

Arguments

contrast

Contrast name, one of contrasts().

kind

"ora" or "gsea".

ExploreDatasetH5AD$enrichment_table()

Tidy enrichment table of one contrast and kind: the table stored in uns$enrichment when present, otherwise derived from enrichment() as in the base class.

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$enrichment_table(contrast, kind)

Arguments

contrast

Contrast name, one of contrasts().

kind

"ora" or "gsea".

ExploreDatasetH5AD$enrichment_input()

Enrichment inputs rebuilt from the DE table: features(), log2 fold changes sorted decreasing, and up/down feature selections at the contrast's FDR and log2FC thresholds.

Usage

ExploreDatasetH5AD$enrichment_input(contrast)

Arguments

contrast

Contrast name, one of contrasts().

se <- readRDS(system.file("examples/proteomics/SummarizedExperiment.rds", package = "exploreDE"))
de <- as.data.frame(rowData(se)$constrast_B_vs_A)
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".h5ad")
build_explore_h5ad(
  x = list(raw = assay(se, "rawData"), transformed = assay(se, "transformedData")),
  out = path,
  omics = "proteomics",
  coldata = colData(se),
  rowdata = de,
  factors = "G_",
  de = list(B_vs_A = de)
)
eds <- ExploreDatasetH5AD$new(path)
eds
